newsitem.title: USA: Group has 5.3 pct of Moore Medical.
newsitem.headline: Group has 5.3 pct of Moore Medical.

text.p: A Boston investment partnership and its general partner said Wednesday they have acquired 154,114 common shares of Moore Medical Corp, or 5.3 percent of the total outstanding.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the partnership, Hollybank Investments LP, and its general partner, Dorsey Gardner, said they acquired the stake for investment purposes.
The stake includes 31,400 shares that were bought between Sept. 26 and Nov. 26 at prices ranging from $9.560 to $10.20 a share, they said.
